items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/f9fd63931f03b2f3fb1932b765b29fab52ab3b68.png"]NEW Superstrike - This is a pass play. After the ball is snapped, the quarterback launches a deep pass... to himself. That's right - he'll teleport downfield and reappear under the ball like he's starring in his own highlight reel. If he makes the catch, you take control and try to score before the defense piles on. It's high risk, high reward, and highly likely to score.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/8e7b87f4b79d151408349b3969399c50db9d46c9.png"]NEW Quantum Gambit - This defensive dirty trick rips open a quantum rift at the line of scrimmage. The moment the ball carrier crosses it, they get teleported back toward their own endzone. It's the only play in football where you can sack a guy using theoretical physics. Part teleportation, part humiliation - and 100% legal... for now.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/43721b6067917a4af9f3296f58c3c28f57be42a4.png"]Ginormous - defensive Dirty Trick turns your defender into a towering, havoc-wreaking monster. At the snap, he balloons to colossal size - crushing blockers and causing instant fumbles with bone-shattering hits. Press button for a Smash Wave or button for a Foot Stomp. He deals huge damage but can still be hurt. Take too many hits, and he shrinks back to normal.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/340a3e48e60f031eebfcab8ada460c21cf394eda.png"]Berserk - Before the snap, one defensive player gets jacked full of berserk rage steroids, mutating him into a living weapon. Spikes erupt from his body, all skill ratings max out, he goes into full kill mode, and anyone in his path takes maximum damage. It only lasts a few seconds - but that's more than enough for a body count.

Hey MFL Communityːer_waveː

We want to thank you for your patience and unwavering support of Mutant Football League 2. It’s been a wild and challenging journey to get us here—but today, we’re thrilled to announce the release of Dynasty Supreme to Steam Early Access!
Added Dynasty Supreme game mode:
Draft new players each year;
Chose Default or create your own Custom Team;
Custom Playbooks: available for both Default and Custom Teams;
Added 5 new parody teams with stadiums, playbooks, customizations:
Deadlanta Vultures;
Gnashville Lycans;
Leaveland Burns;
Lost Wages Invaders;
Sinsonasty Mangles;
Added ability to chose Mayhem Bowl arena in the Mayhem Bowl game mode;
Roster Updates to reflect 2025 season start, including the latest major trades, roster cuts and players balancing;
Bug Fixes and Improvements:
Fixed the issue causing players get XP in the Season Mode;
Fixed bug causing Skillroids working incorrectly;
Fixed the issue that doesn't allow substituted some players;
Fixed a bug which didn't allow change Depth Chart for some players;
Various additional bug fixes.

This is a massive new game mode packed with depth and features. Please keep in mind: this version isn’t final. You’ll encounter bugs, some VO issues, stat tuning problems, and other rough edges. But the core gameplay systems are in place—and you can dive right in using your created teams or default teams.
Over the next six weeks, we’ll be rolling out new content, balancing gameplay, and polishing every aspect of the mode. That’s where you come in.
Tell us what you think! Report bugs, share feedback, and let us know how it feels—too hard, too easy, or just right? Your input will help us make Dynasty Supreme the best version possible.

We’re in Act 3 of our journey toward full release. You’ve been with us since day one, and this final push wouldn’t be possible without your continued passion and support. From the entire MFL team—thank you for believing in us, for playing, and for helping us make Mutant Football League 2 even more insane.
The Digital Dreams Entertainment Team
